quests.instruction: A family takes a day trip to a desert where afternoons are very hot and nights get cold. Which clothing plan fits best?
quests.correctAnswer: Loose long sleeves, wide hat, and a warm evening layer 🏜️
options: Tank top and shorts all day and night 🎽
A thick wool sweater worn all day 🧶
Loose long sleeves, wide hat, and a warm evening layer 🏜️
quests.hint: Think about the big change in temperature.
quests.explanation: Loose, light sleeves and a hat protect from the sun, and a warm layer is ready for the cold night.
quests.funFact: Desert nights can be much colder than the days because dry air holds little heat.

quests.instruction: Why do many people who live in very hot, dry places wear loose, long clothes?
quests.correctAnswer: They shade the skin and let air move 🌬️
options: They shade the skin and let air move 🌬️
They are heavier so they keep heat in 🏋️
They keep rain out of the desert 🌧️
quests.hint: Covered does not have to mean hot.
quests.explanation: Loose fabric keeps sun off the skin while air moving under it helps cooling.
quests.funFact: Loose, flowing clothes have been worn in many hot regions for centuries.

quests.instruction: The desert evening turns cold quickly, and Mei has only sandals. What should she add?
quests.correctAnswer: Closed shoes and socks 🧦
options: A sun visor and sunglasses 🧢
Closed shoes and socks 🧦
A swimsuit and a towel 🩱
quests.hint: Which part of her is least protected?
quests.explanation: Closed shoes and socks keep feet warm when the ground cools.
quests.funFact: The ground cools down after sunset.

quests.instruction: Lina is going on a lake boat ride. It will be breezy with some splashing. Which plan is best?
quests.correctAnswer: Quick-dry clothes, windproof layer, grippy shoes, life jacket 🛶
options: Cotton hoodie, canvas sneakers, and no life jacket 👟
Quick-dry clothes, windproof layer, grippy shoes, life jacket 🛶
Heavy jeans, a wool sweater, and leather shoes 🧶
quests.hint: Think about water, wind, and safety.
quests.explanation: Quick-dry clothes stay comfortable if wet, a windproof layer blocks the breeze, and a life jacket is essential on boats.
quests.funFact: Always wear a life jacket that fits snugly.

quests.instruction: Why are shoes with non-slip soles a good idea on a boat deck?
quests.correctAnswer: Wet decks are slippery 🛥️
options: Shoes keep the boat balanced ⚖️
Dry decks are too sticky to walk on 🩴
Wet decks are slippery 🛥️
quests.hint: Consider the surface.
quests.explanation: Water on a deck makes it very slippery, and grippy soles help you keep your balance.
quests.funFact: Boat shoes often have soles with tiny cuts to grip wet surfaces.

quests.instruction: Kofi's cotton sweatshirt gets splashed on the boat and the wind is cool. What is the problem?
quests.correctAnswer: Wet cotton holds water and chills him 🥶
options: Cotton blocks the wind when it is wet 🌬️
Cotton gets lighter when it is wet 🪶
Wet cotton holds water and chills him 🥶
quests.hint: Focus on wet clothes and wind.
quests.explanation: Cotton soaks up water and then wind makes it feel cold. A waterproof or quick-dry layer is better.
quests.funFact: Many sailors avoid cotton for this reason.

quests.instruction: A family visits a hot, humid place where heavy rain falls suddenly. Which jacket is most practical?
quests.correctAnswer: A light, breathable rain jacket or poncho 🌧️
options: A heavy waterproof winter coat 🧥
A light, breathable rain jacket or poncho 🌧️
A wool cardigan 🧶
quests.hint: Warm and wet at the same time.
quests.explanation: A light rain layer keeps you dry without overheating in the warm air.
quests.funFact: In tropical places, rain is often warm.

quests.instruction: Which footwear suits warm weather and sudden downpours?
quests.correctAnswer: Quick-drying sandals with straps 🩴
options: Leather boots with thick soles 🥾
Suede shoes that look smart 👞
Quick-drying sandals with straps 🩴
quests.hint: Think of shoes that can get wet and dry fast.
quests.explanation: Strap sandals let water drain and dry quickly, and the straps keep them on.
quests.funFact: Leather and suede soak up water and dry slowly.

quests.instruction: Why can a poncho feel more comfortable than a closed raincoat in hot, humid rain?
quests.correctAnswer: Air can flow under it, so you sweat less 🌬️
options: Air can flow under it, so you sweat less 🌬️
It is always warmer than a raincoat 🔥
It keeps rain out better than any coat 🌧️
quests.hint: Where does your body heat go under it?
quests.explanation: A poncho hangs loosely, so air moves under it and heat can escape.
quests.funFact: Closed raincoats can trap heat and sweat.

quests.instruction: Priya is trying skiing for the first time. Why are goggles or sunglasses helpful on a bright snowy day?
quests.correctAnswer: Snow reflects sunlight, so eyes need protection ❄️
options: Cold air makes eyes get too warm 🔥
Snow is dark, so eyes need more light ⚫
Snow reflects sunlight, so eyes need protection ❄️
quests.hint: Focus on what bright white snow does to light.
quests.explanation: Snow reflects a lot of sunlight into your eyes, so goggles reduce glare and protect them.
quests.funFact: Eyes can get sunburned from bright reflected light.

quests.instruction: Why might skiers wear a neck warmer on a chairlift?
quests.correctAnswer: Cold wind blows hard while they ride ⛷️
options: Cold wind blows hard while they ride ⛷️
It keeps snow from melting on the lift ❄️
It stops the ski poles from tangling 🎿
quests.hint: Moving through cold air.
quests.explanation: A neck warmer blocks cold air at the neck, a gap where wind can enter.
quests.funFact: Chairlifts can be much colder than the snow below because of the wind.

quests.instruction: Ben enters a warm ski lodge with a lot of layers on. What is smart to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Open or remove outer layers so he doesn't sweat 🏠
options: Open or remove outer layers so he doesn't sweat 🏠
Keep every layer zipped to stay warm 🤐
Put on an extra coat over everything 🧥
quests.hint: Think about heat inside.
quests.explanation: Taking off layers indoors keeps him from sweating, which would make him cold when he goes back out.
quests.funFact: Sweat cools quickly when you stop moving.

quests.instruction: A class visits a farm with animals and muddy paths. Which clothes are the best choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Long pants, closed shoes, and clothes that can get dirty 🚜
options: A party dress and shiny white sneakers 👗
Shorts, sandals, and a new white shirt 🩴
Long pants, closed shoes, and clothes that can get dirty 🚜
quests.hint: Think about mud, animals, and protection.
quests.explanation: Dirty ground and animals call for protective, washable clothes and shoes that cover feet.
quests.funFact: Farm visitors are often asked to wear boots.

quests.instruction: Why should you wash your hands and change clothes after you visit animals?
quests.correctAnswer: Animal dirt and germs can cling to hands and clothes 🐄
options: Animal dirt and germs can cling to hands and clothes 🐄
Hands get colder after touching animals ❄️
Clothes shrink when animals touch them 📉
quests.hint: Remember what clothes touch.
quests.explanation: Animals carry germs that can pass to you. Washing and changing keeps them out of your home.
quests.funFact: Wash hands for 20 seconds.

quests.instruction: Why should you avoid loose, dangling clothing near farm machinery?
quests.correctAnswer: It can get caught in moving parts ⚙️
options: It makes farm workers too warm 🔥
It gets wet from the animals' water 💧
It can get caught in moving parts ⚙️
quests.hint: What could a machine grab?
quests.explanation: Loose cloth or strings can be caught by machinery and pull someone in.
quests.funFact: Farm and workshop rules often include tying hair back.

quests.instruction: Noor's school-play costume has a long cape. What makes it safest for walking up stage steps?
quests.correctAnswer: Hem that stops above her ankles 🎭
options: A cape that drags on the floor 🧣
Hem that stops above her ankles 🎭
A tight collar 👔
quests.hint: Think about tripping.
quests.explanation: A cape that doesn't touch the floor won't tangle under her feet.
quests.funFact: Costume designers think about safety as well as looks.

quests.instruction: A costume mask has small eye holes. What matters most?
quests.correctAnswer: She can see and breathe easily 😷
options: She can see and breathe easily 😷
It shines under the stage lights ✨
It matches the rest of her costume 🎨
quests.hint: What happens if she cannot see or breathe well?
quests.explanation: Seeing and breathing clearly matter most, because a mask that blocks either can be unsafe.
quests.funFact: Face paint can be a safer choice than a stiff mask.

quests.instruction: Hot stage lights make the actors warm. What should Zoya wear under her heavy costume?
quests.correctAnswer: A light, breathable shirt 👕
options: A wool sweater 🧶
A light, breathable shirt 👕
A raincoat 🌧️
quests.hint: Heat builds under costumes.
quests.explanation: A light base layer keeps her comfortable and absorbs sweat under heavy fabric.
quests.funFact: Stage lights can be very hot.

quests.instruction: Sam is pulling weeds from a bed with thorny bushes. What helps his hands most?
quests.correctAnswer: Sturdy garden gloves 🧤
options: Sturdy garden gloves 🧤
No gloves 🙈
Mittens knitted from wool 🧶
quests.hint: Thorns can scratch.
quests.explanation: Tough gloves protect hands from thorns and keep them clean.
quests.funFact: Garden gloves are often made of leather or coated fabric.

quests.instruction: Why should you wear closed shoes when digging in the garden?
quests.correctAnswer: A spade or stone could hurt your toes 🌱
options: Soil damages sandals more than shoes 🪱
Sandals are too heavy for digging 🏋️
A spade or stone could hurt your toes 🌱
quests.hint: Focus on the tools.
quests.explanation: Closed shoes protect toes from tools and sharp things in the soil.
quests.funFact: Gardeners often wear boots.

quests.instruction: Why tuck pant legs into socks when walking through tall grass?
quests.correctAnswer: To keep ticks and insects off the skin 🐜
options: To keep ticks and insects off the skin 🐜
To make the pants warmer 🔥
To make socks stay dry in grass 🧦
quests.hint: Think about crawling creatures.
quests.explanation: Tucked pants make it harder for ticks and insects to reach the skin.
quests.funFact: Check your skin and clothes for ticks after being in tall grass.

quests.instruction: Lina is packing for a sleepover. Which clothing is most sensible to include?
quests.correctAnswer: Pajamas, warm socks, and tomorrow's clothes 🎒
options: Three winter coats and a scarf 🧥
Pajamas, warm socks, and tomorrow's clothes 🎒
Just a swimsuit and a towel 🩱
quests.hint: Focus on the night and the next morning.
quests.explanation: Sleepwear, warm socks, and a change of clothes cover the night and the next day.
quests.funFact: A small bag is easier to carry than a big one.

quests.instruction: At a campsite, Ravi's boots got soaked. What helps them dry overnight?
quests.correctAnswer: Take out the insoles, stuff with paper, and air them 🥾
options: Put them inside the sleeping bag 🛏️
Take out the insoles, stuff with paper, and air them 🥾
Seal them in a plastic bag overnight 🛍️
quests.hint: Moisture must be able to leave.
quests.explanation: Dry paper absorbs moisture, and air helps the boots dry.
quests.funFact: Never put wet boots too close to a fire.

quests.instruction: Near a campfire, which clothing is the safest choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Snug clothes made of cotton or wool 🔥
options: Fluffy polyester fleece 🐑
Long, loose synthetic scarf 🧣
Snug clothes made of cotton or wool 🔥
quests.hint: Loose and synthetic materials can be risky.
quests.explanation: Snug cotton or wool is less likely to catch sparks or melt than loose synthetic fabric.
quests.funFact: Some synthetic fabrics melt when they get hot.

quests.instruction: Yuki lives where it is hot and is visiting a snowy city in January. Which shopping list is the most useful?
quests.correctAnswer: Thermal base layer, warm hat, gloves, and a coat ❄️
options: Thermal base layer, warm hat, gloves, and a coat ❄️
Sunglasses, sandals, and a cotton shirt 🩴
Swimsuit, shorts, and a sun hat 🩱
quests.hint: She needs a plan for cold.
quests.explanation: The thermal layer, hat, gloves, and coat cover the main ways cold gets in.
quests.funFact: Visitors to cold places often borrow gear at first.

quests.instruction: Zoe is packing for a trip to a place she has never been. What is a helpful step?
quests.correctAnswer: Ask someone who lives there about the weather 🌍
options: Pack only shorts and sandals 🩳
Ask someone who lives there about the weather 🌍
Guess and pack whatever is on top 🤷
quests.hint: People who live there know best.
quests.explanation: Local people can tell you about weather and what's practical to wear.
quests.funFact: Online forecasts can help too.

quests.instruction: A friend from a hot country has never worn snow boots. What should they check first?
quests.correctAnswer: That they are waterproof and fit over thick socks 🥾
options: That they are a favorite color 🎨
That they are very shiny ✨
That they are waterproof and fit over thick socks 🥾
quests.hint: Fit and function.
quests.explanation: Boots that fit with thick socks and keep water out are warm and comfortable.
quests.funFact: Try boots on with the socks you'll be wearing.

quests.instruction: Zoya joins a tour of a cold cave where water drips from the ceiling. Which plan makes the most sense?
quests.correctAnswer: Waterproof jacket, warm layers, grippy boots, helmet 🪖
options: T-shirt, shorts, and open sandals 🩴
Waterproof jacket, warm layers, grippy boots, helmet 🪖
A cotton hoodie and canvas sneakers 🧥
quests.hint: Cold, wet, and slippery.
quests.explanation: Waterproof outer layers keep drips off, warm layers hold heat, grippy boots help on wet rock, and a helmet protects her head.
quests.funFact: Caves stay cool all year.

quests.instruction: A class visits a bakery with hot ovens and flour dust. Which clothing is safest?
quests.correctAnswer: Closed shoes, hair tied back, and no dangling sleeves 🥖
options: Long scarves and loose, floppy sleeves 🧣
Closed shoes, hair tied back, and no dangling sleeves 🥖
Flip-flops and a baggy sweater 🩴
quests.hint: Hot equipment and moving tools.
quests.explanation: Closed shoes protect from spills, and close-fitting clothes won't touch hot surfaces.
quests.funFact: Bakers often wear aprons and hats.

quests.instruction: A new situation comes up. Which set of questions helps you choose clothes best?
quests.correctAnswer: What's the weather, what will I do, and what could go wrong? 🤔
options: What's the weather, what will I do, and what could go wrong? 🤔
What color do I like best, and what's new? 🌈
What is everyone else wearing today? 👥
quests.hint: Think of useful questions.
quests.explanation: Weather, activity, and possible problems shape what you need.
quests.funFact: Preparing for the day makes it easier.
